requirements.statement: Evidence classes and change types distinguish planning readiness, implementation acceptance, and landed completion authority.
Planning-only evidence is labeled as readiness and cannot grant implementation verification, SHIP, or seal eligibility.
Implementation acceptance requires changed implementation paths and behavioral evidence rather than planning files or doctor checks alone.
Lifecycle and next-action decisions remain truthful for failed, unimplemented, verified, sealed, and anchored changes.
Planning-only changes retain an explicit legitimate completion path without weakening implementation-change requirements.
The evidence-class contract and lifecycle invariant are documented and enforced by focused repository-native tests.
